text:
Maya Chen: Quick check — Helio sent the updated solution brief package. Two logo variants (color + mono), a hardware schematic PNG, and a high-res PDF of the technical diagram. We want to publish the brief to the cloud marketplace next week. Need design + legal quick pass on logos and the diagrams. Attaching files.

Alex Rivera: Got it. Can you confirm the requested treatments? clearspace, background options, and which logo to use on dark tiles?

Maya Chen: They want primary color logo on white tiles, mono on dark, and a lockup with Redwood + Helio for the hero (approved by product). Also need alt text and a short caption for marketplace listing.

BrandBot: Uploaded files: helio_primary.svg, helio_mono.svg, helio-lockup.svg, helio-schematic-1200px.png, helio-techdiag-v3.pdf (link: https://files.internal/helio-brief).

Alex Rivera: Quick visual notes:
```
- Clearspace = 24px (around primary)
- Min logo width = 32px for UI, 90px for hero images
- Mono variant must be pure #FFFFFF on dark backgrounds
- Lockup spacing: 16px between logos
```

Priya Singh (Legal): Need written confirmation from Helio on logo usage rights for marketplace and co-marketing emails. Also confirm no export-control tech specs in the public schematic. If there are any operational thresholds in the diag, we should redact.

Nate - Helio (partner): @Priya we have rights for marketing and marketplace — sending the signed brand use addendum now. The schematic is high-level: no vendor-specific power tables, just architecture. I'll remove the small telemetry table I accidentally left in.

Sophia Patel: Also: localization — marketplace listing will be in en/us + fr + de for launch. Do we need translated captions? Helio can provide fr/de once we finalize the English caption.

Liam O'Connor: For the marketplace tile, can design export a 1:1 square and a 16:9 hero from the same art? Need the 1:1 at 1200x1200 and hero at 1920x1080, both with logo set at center-right.

Alex Rivera: Yep, I can produce both. One ask: can we get the vector lockup with separate logo layers (not flattened), SVG or AI preferred. Helio, please send layered source.

Nate - Helio (partner): Uploading layered SVG and AI now. Also sending localized captions after Priya confirms legal redaction.

Maya Chen: Plan: design to do the export + small redaction pass, legal to confirm addendum + schematic redaction by EOD. Can we do a 15-min sync at 3:00pm PST to sign off? @Alex @Priya @Nate :thumbsup:

Alex Rivera: +1, 3pm works for me.

Priya Singh (Legal): I'll review the addendum and the PDF by 2:30pm. If anything major, I'll flag it earlier. 3pm OK.

Nate - Helio (partner): 3pm works. Sending the updated files in 5.

Maya Chen: Thanks — will post the final checklist in the thread after the call.

(BrandBot): Reminder: marketplace asset checklist template created at https://internal.templates/marketplace-checklist — use before upload.

Alex Rivera: Small content callout for the brief copy: avoid product performance numbers like "2x" unless Helio provides a citation. Use qualitative phrasing instead.

Maya Chen: Noted. We'll keep copy conservative until we have benchmarks.

Priya Singh (Legal): All good from legal side after review — addendum received, schematic redacted. OK to proceed to final exports.

Maya Chen: Great — attaching final exports and marketplace captions. Marking this thread as ready for upload. Thank you everyone :tada:
